subject: [RFC PATCH 10/57] mm/collapse: run a round and feed the outcomes back

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch introduces a new function, collapse_round(), which runs a round of candidate evaluation and classification. The function iterates over the batch of candidates, applying passes to each one until it reaches a freeze point or the table is abandoned. The outcomes of these evaluations are then fed back into selection through the collapse_classify_result() function, allowing for decisions on what comes next in the process.
